description: Rescoring of tree-search recipes on five rolling-origin windows: late West Africa (Jan-Jun 2015), mid Kivu (Mar-Aug 2019), BDBV 6 Jun-18 Jul, 25 Jul-29 Aug, 5 Sep-3 Oct 2026. Each window trains on every week before it (latest values). 150 best by search score (BDBV Jun-Aug), 50 random others, and the root reference. Score: natural-scale WIS over locations per window; ranked by the geometric mean over windows of WIS relative to the root reference. Lower is better.
